waythread.configuration.title: BiFang's Bag of Curiosities Settings
waythread.configuration.loadDistance.too: Range for generating and showing the trail.
waythread.configuration.recordPointSpaci: Travel distance between recorded points. Defaults to 5 blocks.
waythread.configuration.maxRecordedPoint: Pause recording when the route reaches this many points.
waythread.configuration.returnEraseDista: Range for matching a recorded point and trimming the route back to it.
waythread.configuration.displayMode.tool: Show a continuous line or mark recorded points. Both modes support the direction highlight.
waythread.configuration.particleStyle.to: Choose the trail's particle style, also used by the Particles start marker.
waythread.configuration.trailParticleSpa: Space between particles along the trail line.
waythread.configuration.trailParticleLim: Maximum trail particles per refresh. Slide all the way right for Unlimited.
waythread.configuration.trailColor.toolt: Color of the trail and direction highlight. Use #RRGGBB.
waythread.configuration.anchorFollowsTra: Use the same color for the start marker and trail.
waythread.configuration.anchorColor.tool: Used when matching the trail color is disabled. Use #RRGGBB.
waythread.configuration.anchorAppearance: Choose how the start marker looks.
waythread.configuration.anchorSeeThrough: Show the start marker itself through blocks.
Maximum distance for seeing the start marker while see-through is enabled.
waythread.configuration.showRecordingDir: Move a highlight toward the trail's end while recording.
waythread.configuration.showReturnProgre: Show the percentage of recorded points cleared on this return trip.
waythread.configuration.returnProgressFo: Height of the text above the progress bar in GUI pixels.
waythread.configuration.showArrivalMessa: Show a message and chime when you reach the start.
waythread.configuration.clearOnArrival.t: Clear the start marker when you finish returning.
